payload.body_you: Saturn in Aries puts pressure on pace. Every request can start looking urgent. You skip lunch to stay ahead, push past the warning signs, and save one afternoon at the expense of the rest of the week. Decide what must happen today, what can wait, and what should never have landed on your list. You do not need to prove you can survive your schedule.
payload.body_they: Saturn in Aries puts pressure on their pace. Every request can start looking urgent; they skip lunch to stay ahead, push past the warning signs, and save one afternoon at the expense of the week. Surviving their own schedule stops being something to prove.

ownerConfirmationStatement: the writing that was being shown in the natal chart was approved
